title: Chrome blank/white page detection and recovery
desc: Chrome renders completely white/blank -- rendering give-up state. Detect via BLANK state in ask poll, recover by closing tab and reopening.
steps: DETECTION: AskCommands.ChatGpt.SendWait.cs polls page state. When state=='BLANK' for 20+ iterations (or 3+ after 30s), it sets blankPageCount>=blankLimit and aborts with '[ASK] Page unresponsive -> aborting poll'. No auto-recovery, no suggest filed.
SYMPTOM: Chrome window shows completely white/blank. CDP eval returns 'BLANK'. ask gpt/gemini times out silently.
ROOT CAUSE: Chrome renderer process died or entered unrecoverable state. Tab shows blank white page. GetAwaiter loop exits with null response.

RECOVERY PROCEDURE: (1) wkappbot cdp close {grap} -- close the blank tab. (2) wkappbot cdp open https://chatgpt.com -- reopen fresh tab. (3) Verify: wkappbot ask gpt --new-session --sync --timeout 30s ping. (4) If still blank: wkappbot --sudo eye restart -- full Chrome hot-swap.

CURRENT BUG: blankPageCount>=blankLimit just breaks loop. Should: (a) file BUG-AUTO suggest, (b) close blank tab, (c) cdp open to relaunch, (d) retry ask. Fix needed in AskCommands.ChatGpt.SendWait.cs and AskCommands.Gemini.cs BLANK state handler.
AUTO-DETECT via cdp-mon: powershell -File D:/GitHub/WKAppBot/bin/wkcdpmon.ps1 -- shows LAT=BLANK when tab is unresponsive. CRIT flag triggers when Chrome blank detected.

WHISPER-RING IMPACT: WhisperStudy reaches Tier 4 (give-up) when BLANK persists across all retries. Eye watchdog sees process alive but rendering dead -- no auto-recovery. Fix: WhisperStudy should signal Eye when all tiers exhausted so Eye can force-restart Chrome.
author: claude
